name: cinematic-scroll-skill
description: Installer for Web Design Studio: three free agent skills (cinematic-scroll, scroll-audit, launch-page-strategy) for websites people remember.

scripts.test:workflow: node --test tools/verify/verify.test.mjs tools/verify/preflight-3d.test.mjs tools/tastehq/tastehq.test.mjs tools/page-proof/matrix.test.mjs tools/page-proof/request-failure.test.mjs tools/check-package.test.mjs tools/choreography.test.mjs tools/cinematic-doctor/stylesheets.test.mjs tools/media-archive.test.mjs tools/check-media-size.test.mjs tools/check-skills.test.mjs tools/check-site-links.test.mjs
scripts.components:doctor: for f in components/mode-a/*.html; do node tools/cinematic-doctor/cli.mjs "$f" --min 80 --quiet || exit 1; done
scripts.learn:selftest: node tools/learn/lib/frontmatter.mjs --selftest && node tools/learn/validate-ir.mjs --selftest && node tools/learn/sync-manifest.mjs --selftest && node tools/learn/check-pointers.mjs --selftest && node tools/learn/surface-dedup-candidates.mjs --selftest
scripts.bench:selftest: node tools/bench/score.mjs --selftest && node tools/bench/cli.mjs --selftest && node bench/build-leaderboard.mjs --selftest
scripts.test: npm run runtime:check && npm run test:runtime && npm run tokens:check && npm run themes:check && npm run links:check && npm run consistency:check && npm run learn:selftest && npm run skill:sync:check && npm run components:doctor && npm run doctor:selftest && npm run evals:run && npm run bench:selftest && npm run test:workflow && npm run media:check && npm run skills:check && npm run site:check && npm run test:install
scripts.build:themes: for f in themes/*.theme.json; do node tools/build-tokens/build.mjs --theme "$f"; done
scripts.prepack: npm run runtime:check && npm run check:lab && npm run check:flagship
scripts.clawhub:scan: npm run clawhub:validate && for s in skills/*/; do skillspector scan "$s" --no-llm || exit 1; done
